title: Stage 1 data-source decision, acquisition protocol, normalization spec, and validation battery
note: This file contains no timestamp by design. The authoritative declaration time and the digest of this file are recorded in governance/STAGE_1_PREREGISTRATION.json, which is written after this file and therefore cannot be embedded in it.

provider_decision.access_mode: unofficial public chart endpoint via the yfinance client
selection_rationale: Stage 0 STAGE_0_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md section 11 recorded two provider reachability probes as inputs to this decision, not as post-hoc discoveries.
Stooq returned an anti-bot HTML page rather than CSV for the documented CSV endpoint and is therefore not usable as an automated no-key provider from this environment.
Yahoo Finance returned a parseable daily series with an explicit adjusted-close column and separate dividend and split action series, which is the minimum needed to satisfy constitution section 6.
No paid provider was evaluated because no purchase is authorized.
known_provider_weaknesses_declared_in_ad: Unofficial endpoint with no service-level guarantee and no published schema contract; it may change or be withdrawn without notice.
Yahoo Finance terms permit personal, non-commercial use and do not permit redistribution. Acquired data therefore stays local and git-ignored, and is never committed or published.
No point-in-time index-membership history and no delisted-security coverage, which is the direct cause of the universe narrowing declared in stage1_universe_spec.json.
Historical values are subject to silent vendor revision. This is mitigated by immutable raw preservation plus hash comparison on every rerun, not by trusting the vendor.

Single-provider risk is not mitigated. There is no second free provider available in this environment, so no cross-provider agreement check is possible. This is recorded as an unresolved Stage 1 limitation.

fallback_policy.on_symbol_exhausted: mark symbol ACQUISITION_FAILED, exclude it from the realized universe, record it; never substitute another symbol
fallback_policy.on_provider_requiring_payment: stop the stage and ask the project owner; never purchase, subscribe, or create an account

acquisition_protocol.why_auto_adjust_is_false: Constitution section 6 requires retaining adjusted and unadjusted OHLCV or documenting a verified transformation between them. auto_adjust=True would discard the unadjusted series and make that verification impossible.
acquisition_protocol.sequencing: one symbol per request, sequential, minimum 1.0 s spacing between requests

raw_storage.on_existing_file_with_different_content: keep the original, write the new payload to data/quarantine/, record a PROVIDER_REVISION anomaly, and do not silently replace

session_key.definition: the calendar date of the provider timestamp expressed in America/New_York
session_key.rationale: A daily bar is identified by its trading session, not by an instant. Storing an instant invites silent timezone drift; the session date is checked against the XNYS calendar instead.

normalization_spec.determinism_requirement: identical raw bytes must produce byte-identical normalized output on any platform
normalization_spec.row_policy: no row is ever silently dropped; a row failing a sanity rule is retained, flagged, and copied to data/quarantine with a reason

adjustment_semantics.method: The normalizer measures whether the provider's unadjusted OHLC series is already split-adjusted by testing the close-to-close step across a known split in the reference fixture, and records the measured result in the normalized manifest.

checks.rule: every normalized session is an XNYS trading session
no session key appears more than once
session keys are sorted and strictly increasing
no session is later than the acquisition date in America/New_York
low <= min(open, close) and max(open, close) <= high, and all four prices are finite and strictly positive
adj_close is finite and strictly positive
on the final session, adj_close equals close within tolerance
the adjustment factor adj_close/close is non-decreasing forward in time within tolerance
every recorded split produces the expected step in the adjustment factor within tolerance
every recorded dividend produces an adjustment-factor step consistent with the dividend amount and the prior close within tolerance
the declared reference corporate actions reproduce their expected adjustment steps
fraction of XNYS sessions missing inside the symbol's own first-to-last range is at most 0.01
no run of consecutive missing XNYS sessions exceeds 5
any absolute adjusted close-to-close return above 0.50 is explained by a recorded split or dividend, otherwise it is quarantined for explanation
minimum close over the development window is at least USD 5.00

validation_battery.measurement_window_restriction: Every quantitative eligibility measurement is computed on development-window data only. No eligibility decision may read validation-window or holdout-window values.

steps: lock the most recent 24 complete calendar months as the final holdout
lock the preceding 36 complete calendar months as validation and walk-forward assessment
use all earlier eligible history as development, subject to a minimum of five years

explicit_non_authorizations_restated: no paid data, purchase, subscription, or account creation
no credential access; Alpaca tradability and fractional eligibility remain UNVERIFIED at Stage 1
no order of any kind, paper or live
no strategy computation, signal, parameter, or performance figure
no read of holdout-window data for any eligibility or quality decision
